walkthroughs.body_html: A sustainable city works for people today without ruining the environment for tomorrow. It uses less energy, cuts waste, and protects nature.
Over half the world lives in cities, producing most CO₂ emissions. Making cities sustainable is vital to tackle climate change.
Sustainable cities have: renewable energy, good public transport, green spaces, recycling, affordable housing and walkable streets.

mcqs.q: Why is 'renewable' not the same as 'clean' energy?
options: El Nino is the name of a specific hurricane that hit Mexico.
Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
All renewable energy sources are clean and have no environmental impact.

Renewable means the source replenishes naturally on human timescales; clean means low environmental/health impact. Hydropower is renewable but floods habitats; bioenergy is renewable but can drive deforestation.
Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs — balancing economic, social and environmental goals.
Sustainable development means stopping all economic growth.
